newsitem.title: UK: Smith & Nephew sees conditions still tough.
newsitem.headline: Smith & Nephew sees conditions still tough.

text.p: Healthcare group Smith & Nephew Plc said on Monday that overall group sales growth continues in line with half-year results, although difficult operating conditions continue.

"In its toughest market in the U.S., where price pressure is tightening, Smith & Nephew continues to make progress against its competition whilst showing strong sales growth in Europe and Asia," the company said in a statement.
In August, Smith & Nephew posted first-half turnover of 540 million stg, up from 503 million stg in the year-earlier period.
The UK company said it planned to discuss its research and development programme during meetings with investors and analysts on Tuesday and Wednesday.

Earlier Monday, the company and Advanced Tissue Sciences Inc of California said they planned to submit a pre-market approval (PMA) application for a foot ulcer product to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The product, Dermagraft, was developed under the joint venture between the two companies announced earlier this year.
